geometry.closedComponentGeometry: actual shared six-face box solid with positive mesh scales

passages.scope: finite rays through two authored opening corridors; diagnostic dimensions, no actor traversal or body fit

roof.scope: finite actual beam/gap ray occlusion; rendered shadow inspected separately, not thermal shade or continuous sun simulation

originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against full projected rectangle, including crossing and endpoint/corner distances

waterBacking.scope: actual wet backing under dry land, no water physics

placement.limits: one unchanged default-world off-road authored placement,20sole rays,90passage-floor samples,finite walkability,actual road triangles and conservative full-card envelopes; no owner-world placement, anatomical fit or all-camera visibility guarantee
